mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( IMG_KEY VARCHAR2(40) NOT NULL, REQ_DATE DATE, IMG_STATUS VARCHAR2(10), CHANNEL VARCHAR2(10), FILE_ID VARCHAR2(40) NOT NULL, FILE_URL VARCHAR2(200), METADATA_HASH_CODE VARCHAR2(11), WIDE_YN VARCHAR2(1), IMG_PATH VARCHAR2(200), IMG_URL VARCHAR2(200), REG_DATE DATE, EXP_DATE DATE, DONE_CODE VARCHAR2(10), DONE_CODE_DESC VARCHAR2(200), DONE_DATE DATE, CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY (IMG_KEY) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( IMG_KEY, REQ_DATE, IMG_STATUS, CHANNEL, FILE_ID, METADATA_HASH_CODE, WIDE_YN, IMG_PATH, IMG_URL ) VALUES ( #{parameter.key}, SYSDATE, #{parameter.imageStatus}, #{parameter.channel}, #{parameter.fileId}, #{parameter.metadataHashCode}, #{parameter.wideYn}, #{parameter.imagePath}, #{parameter.imageUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT /* +RULE*/ IMG_KEY AS key, CHANNEL, FILE_ID, METADATA_HASH_CODE AS metadata_hash_code, WIDE_YN, IMG_PATH AS image_path, IMG_URL AS image_url FROM ${tableName} WHERE IMG_STATUS = 'ready' AND REQ_DATE < SYSDATE AND ROWNUM <= 100
SELECT IMG_KEY AS key FROM ${tableName} WHERE IMG_STATUS = 'request' AND REQ_DATE < SYSDATE - 30 / 24 / 60 / 60 AND ROWNUM <= 100
SELECT IMG_KEY AS key, METADATA_HASH_CODE FROM ${tableName} WHERE IMG_STATUS = 'complete' AND EXP_DATE < SYSDATE AND ROWNUM <= 100

SELECT IMG_KEY AS key, IMG_STATUS AS image_status, FILE_ID, TO_CHAR(EXP_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS expire_date, DONE_CODE FROM ${tableName} WHERE METADATA_HASH_CODE = #{metadataHashCode} AND ROWNUM < 2 ORDER BY EXP_DATE DESC
